pages.intro: One shaft per wood; most carry a modifier.

pages.text: $(l)Bounce$(): ricochets up to 3 times. $(l)Boost$(): +40% speed after 0.5s. $(l)Pierce$(): passes through one enemy. $(l)Slowness$(): slows the target. $(l)Health Steal$(): heals you on hit. $(l)Backstab$(): +40% from behind. $(l)Executioner$(): +50% below half health. $(l)Translocation$(): swaps you and the target.

pages.intro: Fletchings tune accuracy: lower spread is steadier.

pages.text: $(l)Homing$(): drifts toward the nearest target. $(l)Recovery$(): sometimes drops back for you to pick up. $(l)Ghostly$(): slips through the first block it hits.$(br2)$(l)Coloured feathers$() (parrot and eagle drops) are cosmetic variants of Feather.
